    def _call_sync_with_timeout(
        self,
        request: ResolvedRequest,
        *,
        timeout_seconds: float | None,
    ) -> LLMRouterResponse:
        """Run one sync executor attempt with optional timeout."""
        if timeout_seconds is None:

proposals.defect: The pool shutdown in finally always waits for the worker thread, even after a timeout. The caller keeps blocking on the timed-out route until it finishes, so fallback or the timeout error comes only after the slow attempt ends.

The timeout is checked after the attempt finishes instead of bounding the wait. The executor runs inline to completion, then elapsed time is compared with the limit. The caller does not stop waiting on the slow route, and the timeout is raised only after the attempt has fully ended.
